question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.

WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT 
        lt.id_bioguide,
        l.gender,
        lt.state,
        CAST(MIN(CASE WHEN lt.term_number = 0 THEN lt.term_start END) AS DATE) as first_term_start
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN legislators l ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    GROUP BY lt.id_bioguide, l.gender, lt.state
),
target_years AS (
    SELECT 
        ft.id_bioguide,
        ft.gender,
        ft.state,
        ft.first_term_start,
        ft.first_term_start + INTERVAL 0 YEAR as check_date_0,
        ft.first_term_start + INTERVAL 2 YEAR as check_date_2,
        ft.first_term_start + INTERVAL 4 YEAR as check_date_4,
        ft.first_term_start + INTERVAL 6 YEAR as check_date_6,
        ft.first_term_start + INTERVAL 8 YEAR as check_date_8,
        ft.first_term_start + INTERVAL 10 YEAR as check_date_10
    FROM first_terms ft
),
retention AS (
    SELECT 
        ty.id_bioguide,
        ty.gender,
        ty.state,
        ty.first_term_start,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = ty.id_bioguide
            AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= ty.check_date_0
            AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= ty.check_date_0
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_0,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = ty.id_bioguide
            AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= ty.check_date_2
            AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= ty.check_date_2
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_2,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = ty.id_bioguide
            AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= ty.check_date_4
            AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= ty.check_date_4
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_4,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = ty.id_bioguide
            AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= ty.check_date_6
            AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= ty.check_date_6
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_6,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = ty.id_bioguide
            AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= ty.check_date_8
            AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= ty.check_date_8
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_8,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = ty.id_bioguide
            AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= ty.check_date_10
            AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= ty.check_date_10
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_10
    FROM target_years ty
),
state_gender_retention AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        COUNT(*) as total_legislators,
        SUM(retained_0) as retained_count_0,
        SUM(retained_2) as retained_count_2,
        SUM(retained_4) as retained_count_4,
        SUM(retained_6) as retained_count_6,
        SUM(retained_8) as retained_count_8,
        SUM(retained_10) as retained_count_10,
        1.0 * SUM(retained_0) / COUNT(*) as retention_rate_0,
        1.0 * SUM(retained_2) / COUNT(*) as retention_rate_2,
        1.0 * SUM(retained_4) / COUNT(*) as retention_rate_4,
        1.0 * SUM(retained_6) / COUNT(*) as retention_rate_6,
        1.0 * SUM(retained_8) / COUNT(*) as retention_rate_8,
        1.0 * SUM(retained_10) / COUNT(*) as retention_rate_10
    FROM retention
    GROUP BY state, gender
),
state_both_check AS (
    SELECT 
        s1.state
    FROM state_gender_retention s1
    JOIN state_gender_retention s2 
        ON s1.state = s2.state 
        AND s1.gender = 'M' 
        AND s2.gender = 'F'
    WHERE s1.gender = 'M' AND s2.gender = 'F'
    AND s1.retention_rate_0 > 0 AND s1.retention_rate_2 > 0 AND s1.retention_rate_4 > 0 AND s1.retention_rate_6 > 0 AND s1.retention_rate_8 > 0 AND s1.retention_rate_10 > 0
    AND s2.retention_rate_0 > 0 AND s2.retention_rate_2 > 0 AND s2.retention_rate_4 > 0 AND s2.retention_rate_6 > 0 AND s2.retention_rate_8 > 0 AND s2.retention_rate_10 > 0
)
SELECT state
FROM state_both_check
ORDER BY state
